concept: A website’s main navigation with panels of described links that open from top-level buttons, at level 4 of the stack.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a mega menu that opens on hover with columns of blue links as the navigation menu
default_to_avoid.kind: navigation menu, mega menu, site navigation
default_to_avoid.why_not: hover-only panels never open on touch and close when the pointer crosses a gap; blue links bring a hue

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: each panel is a level-4 pane under its button

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: panels open on a press, not on hover, and Esc closes them

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: each link has a line of description so the reader chooses by purpose

options: C one long row of links
variants.reason: A works on touch and keyboard (disclosure pattern). B fails both. C runs out of room.

root.why: the navigation, positioning its panels, the same in every theme and on every scene

bar.why: the top-level entries in a row, the same in every theme and on every scene

entry.why: one entry and its panel, the same in every theme and on every scene

top.why: a 44px top-level button or link, the same in every theme and on every scene

chevron.why: a chevron that turns when the panel opens

panel.why: a level-4 panel of links, the same in every theme and on every scene

links.why: the panel’s links in a column, the same in every theme and on every scene

link.why: a described link with room to hit, the same in every theme and on every scene

linkLabel.why: the link name in semibold, the same in every theme and on every scene

description.why: a line in secondary text saying what the page is for

focus-visible.why: the shared focus ring so a keyboard user sees which item has focus

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours mark the current item with the system highlight

hover.why: an entry lightens under the pointer, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-expanded=true.why: an open entry stays lit, the same in every theme and on every scene

rotate.why: the chevron turns at hover pace, the same in every theme and on every scene

@pop.why: the panel drops a short way and settles
